meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides Salesforce's chat widget and autoplay background videos; blur or hide page pictures; hide the customer-logo wall and footer
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, iPhone UA 390x844 in headless Chrome, salesforce.com home page. Counts are `querySelectorAll` on the rendered DOM saved from that load (scripts then switched off to evaluate): chat widget `page-builder-miaw-ui` 1, autoplay videos 1 (plus two paused preload-none videos that are not matched), body pictures 124, logo wall 1, footer custom element `hgf-footer` 1. Salesforce markup is Tailwind utilities with no stable class names, so only tags, `data-testid` and attributes are used; none depend on English text. The background-video rule also matches the captured video's stable `aria-hidden="true"` marker because the serialized fixture does not retain its live `autoplay` attribute.

NOT verified: product and pricing pages, the Trailhead and Help subdomains, desktop layout, the cookie consent banner (none appeared for this session), the original ad and app-banner rules.
